notes.title: New Languages Added to FRACTER
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that we have added new language support for German, Spanish, Italian, Russian, Chinese (Simplfied), and Japanese. 

Open the settings menu from the pause screen to cycle through all the newly added languages.

Thanks to everyone who have been enjoying FRACTER so far.

All the Best,
4L Games Team



P.S.
We also fixed an annoying bug that prevented the "Death by Light" achievement being unlocked.
